notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Restoration Angel.
You control at least one nontoken non-Angel creature with base power 4 or greater.
description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Restoration Angel with haste.
When the Restoration Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any non-Angel you control with base power 4 or greater.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Life Finds A Way triggers, creating a token copy of the Restoration Angel token.
Repeat from step 2.
